svg.title: From the car to the flat-six
svg.desc: The 2010 2.9 engine sits low behind the seats, ahead of the rear axle. Its crankshaft runs along the car; three horizontal cylinders lie on each side. Follow the crankcase, six piston-and-rod assemblies, crankshaft, outer cylinder heads and four camshafts. The intake lies above; the exhaust leaves below the heads. Numbered parts: 1 Crankcase; 2 Crankshaft; 3 Pistons and rods; 4 Right cylinder head; 5 Left cylinder head; 6 Four camshafts; 7 Intake and runners; 8 Exhaust manifolds. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
